'''Jarro Freen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived in [[Gadrin]] on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was a member of [[Borus's Boys]], a street gang that liked to hang around near [[Gadrin Dump]]. However, he was kidnapped by [[Task Force Vermin]], a unit from the [[Thaereian military]], because his mother worked for the [[Office of Peace and Security]] and they wanted to blackmail her.
